caption: The drawing depicts a single ceramic jug positioned centrally on a plain background within a rectangular border. The jug is predominantly grayish in color, with blue decorative accents distributed unevenly, mostly around the neck, handle, and on the body as streaks and spots. The jug features a rounded body, a narrow neck with a slightly flared rim, and a prominent spout. There is a large, curved handle attached from the upper neck to the shoulder of the vessel. On the front of the jug, there is an inscription that reads "[E.G. R.] 1 PINTA" in small, dark letters. The base of the jug is slightly wider than its body, and the inside of the jug is depicted with a brownish-golden tone. The artist's signature, "H. UMAGALLI," is located in the lower right corner outside the border. The entire composition is rendered with careful shading, giving the jug a three-dimensional appearance.
title: Pitcher
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
